result.summary: Bluestone Engineering has one open invoice (INV000701, €1.38M) currently 5 days past due. Settled invoice history shows lateness rising from 3-9 days early in the year to a peak of 15 days late in June, with the most recent settlement at 6 days late - indicating a mildly worsening but volatile payment pattern. Exposure is significant relative to the single insurer's €5.16M credit limit, warranting closer monitoring given the size of individual invoices.
